1. The present petition has been filed under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India praying for
issuance of an appropriate writ, order or direction especially in the nature of certiorari for quashing
the impugned action of respondent No.2, who denied to re-
re-issue issue the passport No.M5754846 of the petitioner, petition valid upto 26.01.2025.
2.
At the outset, on a specific query raised by the Court, learned counsel for the petitioner has failed to demonstrate any order of rejection.

3. Counsel for the respondents-UOI UOI has point out that by virtue of letter dated 20.06.2024 (Annexure P-3), P 3), the petitioner has been duly informed with regard to the adverse police verification report and his involvement in an FIR N.107/2019, under Sections 376, 511, 354, 452 of IPC, registered at Police Station Majitha.

4. Learned counsel unsel for the petitioner has pointed out and argued that the petitioner has been charge-sheeted charge sheeted under Section 354 of IPC, CWP-19611 19611-2024 however, could not deny the fact that the trial is pending.

5. sentences.text: 6. Faced with the above, learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of the present petition, at this stage wi with liberty to the petitioner to move an appropriate application before the trial Court for the relief so prayed.
7. Accordingly, the present petition stands dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.
liberty

It is expected that in case appropriate applicatio application n is filed, the trial Court shall expedite the application considering the fact that the passport of the petitioner is going to expire on 226.01.2025.
8.

It is made clear that this order shall not be construed as any concession or liberty/expression liberty expression of opinion ggranting ranting any permission to the petitioner to go abroad for which the petitioner is at liberty to approach the trial Court for the same.
